text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see it...! A foolproof strategy
to avoid the insane crowd!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us go claim it.
The school store's instant sell-out item—
The "Limited Edition Carrot Melon Bread"...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Tactic number one: deliberately avoid taking the shortest route.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is the peak hour when Umamusume rush to the school store as fast as they can.
By running the opposite way, I can bypass the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Tactic number two: keep track of what's being taught
in other classes as well.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's empty. This class is still in session.
That Japanese teacher keeps lecturing even after the bell rings without a care in the world!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A burst of speed down the final stretch straight to the goal!!
Heh heh, it's so laughably easy it's a joke!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Why is nobody here?
Did my plan work too well?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During lunch break, as I walked past the academy store――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... What's going on...?
There's no staff, and the limited-edition bread is gone too...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Where, where did I mess up?
Was the strategy flawed from the very beginning?
Wait, seriously, are they completely out of stock...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just then, a flyer posted on the storefront
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What...!
"Being sold in the cafeteria to ease congestion"...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How can they just change the regulations so suddenly~~!
Fine, I just have to go, right? I'm going~~!

text_block_list.name: Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
That's all for today's limited-edition bread~!
Thanks, everyone~~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't take this, this is the worst~~~!
I refuse to accept this kind of RNG fiesta--!!
choice_data_list: Still, at least we found the new sales section.
Don't give up—let's ask the lady!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...! That's true...
If the regulations have changed, all we have to do is adapt our strategy to fit them.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I will construct a more meticulous and flawless route
to secure that limited-edition pastry.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This defeat will make me stronger.
Just you wait, limited-edition bread...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... they clearly said it was sold out.
Well, I'll ask just in case, butââ

text_block_list.name: Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, the limited-edition pastries are already――
Oh, there's one left! I overlooked it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
O-Oooohhhh!
That's it, that's the one! Yayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you never know how a match will turn out until the very end.
Hahaha, that was a valuable lesson!
